cues.text: Let's build a question paper from your question bank.
Open Content Creation, then choose Paper Builder.
Choose the class and subject, then finish the title. It starts from your class and subject.
Go to Paper Structure. Sections are optional. A marks warning appears, so press Continue, then choose Type manually.
Type the question, then add it to the paper.
Open the draft to save it. All your papers are listed under Question Papers.
Your paper is now saved as a draft.
